BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to 33 Kingsgrove — a bright and spacious detached  four-bedroom  family home offering a well-designed six-room layout. Ideally presented in turnkey condition, this property is set in a quiet, mature cul-de-sac and benefits from off-street parking and a private garage.
The accommodation includes two bedrooms on the ground floor (one with an ensuite shower room), a modern and well-appointed kitchen/dining area, and a bright, comfortable sitting room and family bathroom. Upstairs, there are two additional bedrooms with wardobes and a w.c., making this an ideal home for families or those seeking flexible living space.
Key Features:
•	Four-bedroom, two-bathroom home with additional guest W.C. 
•	Thoughtfully designed kitchen/dining room and spacious sitting room 
•	Primary bedroom with ensuite shower room 
•	Off-street parking and private garage 
•	Front and rear gardens

A notable feature is the ground floor bedroom complete with its own ensuite bathroom, offering excellent flexibility for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office suite.
The property benefits from oil-fired central heating and 4  bedrooms  ensuring ample space for growing families.
Conveniently located within easy reach of a range of local schools and a commuter train station, this home combines peaceful suburban living with excellent accessibility.

Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only.
Virtual viewings the 3D tour, will give you an idea of the features and layout of the property but there is nothing like a physical in person viewing
Strictly by appointment with the agent JoeMcDonnell 0876726255
